name: Delivering the Relic
summary: At Feathermoon Stronghold, Latronicus Moonspear sends you with the Mysterious Relic to his wife Vestia. He cannot make sense of it, and hopes she can tell what it is.

sections.title: A Scholar's Eye
sections.body: Latronicus Moonspear cannot make sense of the device, wager or no wager. He says his wife Vestia is a fine priestess to their community and one of the most learned scholars anywhere. If anyone can work out what the relic is, she can. They need to know. Vestia is only a short walk away, though she is surely busy studying.

sections.title: Vestia's First Look
sections.body: Vestia Moonspear knows you have aided General Feathermoon and Latro against the naga. At first glance, the relic does not seem to come from the ruins where it was found, nor does it bear naga design. It is something far more alien. Studying it will take time. When she is done, she may call on your talents if you are nearby.

faq.answer: Vestia Moonspear is Latronicus Moonspear's wife. He calls her a fine priestess to their community and one of the most learned scholars anywhere. She is at Feathermoon Stronghold.

faq.q: Where does the Mysterious Relic come from?
aliases: where did the relic come from
faq.answer: The Mysterious Relic is the relic Lord Shalzaru uncovered when the naga were digging in a cave on the Isle of Dread.

faq.q: What does Latronicus Moonspear know about the relic?
faq.answer: Latronicus Moonspear knows little about the relic. He cannot make heads or tails of the device, so he wants his wife to examine it.

faq.q: Where do I take the relic?
faq.answer: Take the Mysterious Relic to Vestia Moonspear at Feathermoon Stronghold. Latronicus says she is just around the bend.
